verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a developer doc about submitting apps to the Microsoft Store. That confirms an official app catalog exists for Windows, but nothing documents users installing from it or its size. missing for 10: documentation of end-user installation from the Store, evidence of a catalog of thousands of apps, any power-user install tooling tied to the catalog, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can install thousands of applications directly from an official software catalog

citations.quote: Submit your app to the Microsoft Store
